scenes.title: Huquqiy va rasmiy hujjatlar tili
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Oldingi darsda akademik yozuvni o‘rgandik. Bugun ingliz tilida huquqiy va rasmiy hujjatlar tilini o‘rganamiz: shartnoma tuzilishi va terminologiyasi, majburiyatlar va shartlar, rasmiy passiv va nominal uslub, mayda printni o‘qish. Dars oxirida 5 ta shartnoma moddasini oddiy so‘zlar bilan tushuntiring. Huquqiy matn — har bir so‘z aniq va majburiy — hech qachon yuzaki o‘qimang.
scenes.say: Welcome to lesson nine of PRO 2! Today we learn legal and formal language: contracts, obligations and the fine print.
scenes.say_uz: PRO 2 ning to‘qqizinchi darsiga xush kelibsiz! Bugun huquqiy va rasmiy hujjatlar tilini o‘rganamiz: shartnomalar, majburiyatlar va mayda print.

scenes.title: Shartnoma tuzilishi: parties, terms, signature

examples.t: WHEREAS the parties wish to collaborate…
NOW THEREFORE the parties agree as follows…

scenes.say_native: Ingliz shartnomasining beshta qismi. Birinchisi — tomonlar — „the parties“ — tomonlar — shartnoma ishtirokchilari — „WHEREAS the parties wish to collaborate“ — ishchi: tomonlar hamkorlik qilishni xohlashadi — bu bayonot — tomonlarning niyati. Ikkinchisi — „WHEREAS“ — aslida — shartnoma boshlanishidagi bayonotlar — „WHEREAS the parties agree to…“. Uchinchisi — „NOW THEREFORE“ — shu bilan — shartnoma asosiy qismi boshlanadi — „NOW THEREFORE the parties agree as follows“ — shu bilan, tomonlar quyidagicha kelishmoqda. To‘rtinchisi — „Terms“ — shartlar — moddalar — raqamlangan. Beshinchisi — imzolar. Eslab qoling: parties — whereas — now therefore — terms — signature — shartnomaning beshta qismi. Shartnomaning beshta qismi — har birini tanib olishingiz kerak — ular imzolanishidan oldin yod oling.
scenes.say: WHEREAS the parties wish to collaborate on the project. NOW THEREFORE the parties agree as follows: clause one, scope of work. Clause two, payment terms. Clause three, duration. The parties hereby sign this agreement.
scenes.say_uz: Tomonlar loyihada hamkorlik qilishni xohlashadi. Shu bilan, tomonlar quyidagicha kelishmoqda: birinchi modda, ish hajmi. Ikkinchi modda, to‘lov shartlari. Uchinchi modda, muddat. Tomonlar shu shartnomani imzolaydilar.

scenes.title: Shartnoma tuzilishi mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta shartnoma qismi gapi tuzing. Birinchi: „WHEREAS the parties wish to collaborate“ — aslida. Ikkinchi: „NOW THEREFORE the parties agree as follows“ — shu bilan. Uchinchi: „the parties hereby sign this agreement“ — imzo. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting. Majburiyatlar — shall — har doim majburiyat — lekin recommend — tavsiya.
scenes.say: WHEREAS the parties wish to collaborate on this project. NOW THEREFORE the parties agree as follows. The parties hereby sign this agreement. Say the three parts of a contract aloud.
scenes.say_uz: Tomonlar ushbu loyihada hamkorlik qilishni xohlashadi. Shu bilan, tomonlar quyidagicha kelishmoqda. Tomonlar shu shartnomani imzolaydilar. Shartnomaning uchta qismini baland ovozda ayting.

scenes.title: Majburiyat va shartlar: shall, must, in the event that

examples.t: The Buyer shall pay within 30 days.
In the event that payment is late…

scenes.say_native: Shartnomadagi to‘rtta muhim so‘z. Birinchisi — „shall“ — majbur qiladi — „The Buyer shall pay within 30 days“ — xaridor 30 kun ichida to‘lashi shart — bu yuridik majburiyat. Ikkinchisi — „in the event that“ — agar shunday bo‘lsa — „In the event that payment is late, interest shall accrue“ — agar to‘lov kechiksa, foiz o‘sadi. Uchinchisi — „provided that“ — sharti bilan — „Provided that the Seller delivers on time“ — sotuvchi o‘z vaqtida yetkazib bersa — shart. To‘rtinchisi — „notwithstanding“ — qaramay — „Notwithstanding clause 5, the contract shall remain valid“ — 5-moddaga qaramay, shartnoma o‘zida qoladi. Eslab qoling: shall — in the event that — provided that — notwithstanding. Rasmiy passiv — huquqiy matnning rasmiy ohangi — siz uni har doim uchratasiz.
scenes.say: The Buyer shall pay within 30 days of delivery. In the event that payment is late, interest shall accrue at 1.5 % per month. Provided that the Seller delivers on time, the Buyer shall accept the goods. Notwithstanding clause 5, the contract shall remain valid.
scenes.say_uz: Xaridor yetkazib berilgandan keyin 30 kun ichida to‘lashi shart. Agar to‘lov kechiksa, oyiga 1,5 foiz foiz o‘sadi. Sotuvchi o‘z vaqtida yetkazib bersa, xaridor tovarlarni qabul qilishi shart. Beshinchi moddaga qaramay, shartnoma o‘zida qoladi.

scenes.title: Majburiyat mashqi
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta majburiyat gapi tuzing: „The Buyer shall pay within 30 days“; „In the event that payment is late, interest shall accrue“; „Provided that the Seller delivers on time…“; „Notwithstanding clause 5…“. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting. Mayda print — hech qachon e‘tiborsiz qoldirmang — ko‘p imtiyozlar shu yerda yashirin.
scenes.say: The Buyer shall pay within 30 days of delivery. In the event that payment is late, interest shall accrue at 1.5 % per month. Provided that the Seller delivers on time, the Buyer shall accept the goods. Notwithstanding clause 5, the contract shall remain valid.
scenes.say_uz: Xaridor 30 kun ichida to‘lashi shart. Agar to‘lov kechiksa, foiz o‘sadi. Sotuvchi o‘z vaqtida yetkazib bersa, xaridor tovarlarni qabul qilishi shart. Beshinchi moddaga qaramay, shartnoma o‘zida qoladi.

scenes.title: Rasmiy passiv va nominal uslub: It is agreed that…

examples.t: It is agreed that the Buyer shall inspect the goods.
The parties hereby agree to the following terms.

scenes.say_native: Huquqiy matnning rasmiy passiv va nominal uslubi. Birinchisi — „It is agreed that…“ — kelishilganki… — passiv, shaxssiz — „It is agreed that the Buyer shall inspect the goods“ — kelishilganki, xaridor tovarlarni tekshirishi shart. Ikkinchisi — „The parties hereby agree to…“ — tomonlar shu orqali kelishmoqda — „Hereby“ — shu bilan — huquqiy tarqatish. Uchinchisi — nominal uslub — fe'l o‘rniga ot — „inspection“ (tekshirish), „termination“ (tugatish), „obligation“ (majburiyat) — „The obligation to inspect rests with the Buyer“ — tekshirish majburiyati xaridorga yuklangan. Eslab qoling: passiv — hereby — nominal uslub — huquqiy matnning rasmiy ohangi. Savollaringizni tayyorlang — ular matnga qaray turib bo‘lsin — ular aniqroq bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: It is agreed that the Buyer shall inspect the goods within 14 days of delivery. The parties hereby agree to the following terms and conditions. The obligation to inspect the goods rests solely with the Buyer. Any failure to inspect shall constitute acceptance.
scenes.say_uz: Kelishilganki, xaridor tovarlarni yetkazib berilgandan keyin 14 kun ichida tekshirishi shart. Tomonlar quyidagi shartlar va shartnomalarga rozi. Tovarlarni tekshirish majburiyati faqat xaridorga yuklangan. Tekshirishdagi har qanday muvaffaqiyatsizlik qabul qilish deb hisoblanadi.

scenes.title: Rasmiy passiv mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta rasmiy gap tuzing: „It is agreed that the Buyer shall inspect the goods“; „The parties hereby agree to the following terms and conditions“; „The obligation to inspect rests with the Buyer“. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting. Javoblaringizni takrorlang — huquqiy matnni tushunish — takrorlashni talab qiladi.
scenes.say: It is agreed that the Buyer shall inspect the goods within 14 days. The parties hereby agree to the following terms and conditions. The obligation to inspect the goods rests with the Buyer.
scenes.say_uz: Kelishilganki, xaridor tovarlarni 14 kun ichida tekshirishi shart. Tomonlar quyidagi shartlar va shartnomalarga rozi. Tovarlarni tekshirish majburiyati xaridorga yuklangan.

scenes.title: Mayda printni o‘qish: fine print, liability, termination

examples.t: The fine print contains critical limitations.
examples.uz: Mayda print juda muhim cheklovlarni o‘z ichiga oladi.

examples.t: The Seller shall not be liable for indirect damages.
examples.uz: Sotuvchi bilvosita zarar uchun javobgar emas.

scenes.say_native: Mayda printni o‘qishning uch qoidasi. Birinchisi — „Fine print“ — mayda print — har doim o‘qing — „The fine print contains critical limitations“ — mayda print juda muhim cheklovlarni o‘z ichiga oladi — ko‘p yutadi. Ikkinchisi — „Liability“ — javobgarlik — „The Seller shall not be liable for indirect damages“ — sotuvchi bilvosita zarar uchun javobgar emas — bu eng ko‘p uchraydigan cheklov. Uchinchisi — „Termination“ — tugatish — „Either party may terminate with 30 days‘ notice“ — har qaysi tomon 30 kun oldin ogohlantirish bilan tugatishi mumkin — „Default“ — to‘lov qila olmaslik — „In the event of default, the contract shall be terminated“ — to‘lov qila olmaslik holatida shartnoma darhol tugatiladi. Eslab qoling: fine print — liability — termination — default.
scenes.say: The fine print contains critical limitations. The Seller shall not be liable for indirect damages. Either party may terminate with 30 days notice. In the event of default, the contract shall be terminated immediately.
scenes.say_uz: Mayda print juda muhim cheklovlarni o‘z ichiga oladi. Sotuvchi bilvosita zarar uchun javobgar emas. Har qaysi tomon 30 kun oldin ogohlantirish bilan tugatishi mumkin. To‘lov qila olmaslik holatida, shartnoma darhol tugatiladi.

scenes.title: Mayda print mashqi
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta mayda print gapi tuzing: „The fine print contains critical limitations“; „The Seller shall not be liable for indirect damages“; „Either party may terminate with 30 days‘ notice“; „In the event of default, the contract shall be terminated immediately“. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting. Javoblaringizni takrorlang — huquqiy matnni tushunish — takrorlash orqali mustahkamlanadi.
scenes.say: The fine print contains critical limitations. The Seller shall not be liable for indirect damages. Either party may terminate with 30 days notice. In the event of default, the contract shall be terminated immediately.
scenes.say_uz: Mayda print juda muhim cheklovlarni o‘z ichiga oladi. Sotuvchi bilvosita zarar uchun javobgar emas. Har qaysi tomon 30 kun oldin ogohlantirish bilan tugatishi mumkin. To‘lov qila olmaslik holatida, shartnoma darhol tugatiladi.

scenes.title: ESCUCHA 1: shartnoma moddasi bo‘yicha suhbat
board: A: What does this clause mean?
B: It says the Buyer shall inspect the goods.
A: What if the Buyer doesn't?
B: The goods shall be deemed accepted.
scenes.say_native: Birinchi suhbatni tinglang — shartnoma moddasi bo‘yicha suhbat. A: „What does this clause mean?“ — bu modda nimani anglatadi? B: „It says the Buyer shall inspect the goods“ — u deydiki, xaridor tovarlarni tekshirishi shart. A: „What if the Buyer doesn't?“ — agar xaridor buni qilmasa nima bo‘ladi? B: „The goods shall be deemed accepted“ — tovarlar qabul qilingan deb hisoblanadi. Diqqat qiling: moddani — oddiy so‘zlar bilan — tushuntiring. Topshiriqni vaqt ichida yozing — 10 daqiqada 5 ta moddani tushuntiring — aniq va qisqa.
scenes.say: What does this clause mean? It says the Buyer shall inspect the goods within 14 days. What if the Buyer doesn't? The goods shall be deemed accepted.
scenes.say_uz: Bu modda nimani anglatadi? U xaridor tovarlarni 14 kun ichida tekshirishi shart deb aytadi. Agar xaridor buni qilmasa nima bo‘ladi? Tovarlar qabul qilingan deb hisoblanadi.

scenes.title: Suhbat 1 bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Suhbat bo‘yicha to‘rtta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: bu modda nimani anglatadi — xaridor tovarlarni tekshirishi shart. Ikkinchi: tekshirish muddati qancha — 14 kun. Uchinchi: agar xaridor tekshirmasa nima bo‘ladi — tovarlar qabul qilingan deb hisoblanadi. To‘rtinchi: ohang — huquqiy va rasmiy. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting. Namuna javoblarni ko‘p marta o‘qing — ular sizga aniq va tushunarli tushuntirishni o‘rgatadi.
scenes.say: What does the clause mean? What is the inspection period? What happens if the Buyer doesn't inspect? What is the tone? Answer in English.
scenes.say_uz: Modda nimani anglatadi? Tekshirish muddati qancha? Agar xaridor tekshirmasa nima bo‘ladi? Ohang qanday? Ingliz tilida javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 1
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Modda: „the Buyer shall inspect the goods within 14 days“ — xaridor tovarlarni 14 kun ichida tekshirishi shart — shall — majburiy tekshirish. Agar tekshirmasa: „The goods shall be deemed accepted“ — tovarlar qabul qilingan deb hisoblanadi — bu passiv huquqiy konstruksiya. Eslab qoling: huquqiy matnda — mayda print — har doim muhim — har bir moddani oddiy so‘zlar bilan tushuntiring. Bugun o‘rganganingizni har kuni takrorlang — huquqiy ingliz tili — mashq orqali o‘zlashtiriladi.
scenes.say: The clause means the Buyer must inspect the goods within 14 days. If the Buyer doesn't inspect, the goods are deemed accepted. Legal clauses are best understood in plain words.
scenes.say_uz: Modda xaridor tovarlarni 14 kun ichida tekshirishi shartligini anglatadi. Agar xaridor tekshirmasa, tovarlar qabul qilingan deb hisoblanadi. Huquqiy moddalar eng yaxshi oddiy so‘zlar bilan tushuniladi.

scenes.title: ESCUCHA 2: majburiyatlar bo‘yicha suhbat
board: B: The Buyer shall pay within 30 days.
B: Interest shall accrue at 1.5 % per month.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi suhbatni tinglang — majburiyatlar bo‘yicha suhbat. A: „What about payment?“ — to‘lov haqida nima? B: „The Buyer shall pay within 30 days“ — xaridor 30 kun ichida to‘lashi shart. A: „And if not?“ — agar to‘lamasa nima? B: „Interest shall accrue at 1.5 % per month“ — oyiga 1,5 foiz foiz o‘sadi. Diqqat qiling: to‘lov — majburiyat — kechikish — foiz — huquqiy oqibatlar. Keyingi dars tibbiyot tili — tibbiyot — huquq kabi muhim professional yo‘nalish.
scenes.say: What about payment? The Buyer shall pay within 30 days. And if not? Interest shall accrue at 1.5 % per month.
scenes.say_uz: To‘lov haqida nima? Xaridor 30 kun ichida to‘lashi shart. Agar to‘lamasa nima? Oyiga 1,5 foiz foiz o‘sadi.

scenes.title: Suhbat 2 bo‘yicha savollar
scenes.say_native: Suhbat bo‘yicha to‘rtta savolga javob bering. Birinchi: to‘lov haqida gap — xaridor to‘lashi shart. Ikkinchi: to‘lov muddati qancha — 30 kun. Uchinchi: agar to‘lamasa nima bo‘ladi — foiz o‘sadi — 1,5 foiz oyiga. To‘rtinchi: ohang — rasmiy va huquqiy. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting. undefined

scenes.say_uz: To‘lov haqida nima deydi? Muddat qancha? Agar xaridor to‘lamasa nima bo‘ladi? Ohang qanday? Ingliz tilida javob bering.

scenes.title: Javoblar: suhbat 2
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. To‘lov: „The Buyer shall pay within 30 days“ — xaridor 30 kun ichida to‘lashi shart. Agar to‘lamasa: „Interest shall accrue at 1.5 % per month“ — oyiga 1,5 foiz foiz o‘sadi — bu huquqiy va rasmiy shart. scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: 5 ta shartnoma moddasini oddiy so‘zlar bilan tushuntiring
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. 5 ta shartnoma moddasini oddiy so‘zlar bilan tushuntiring: 1) tekshirish shart; 2) to‘lov 30 kun; 3) foiz 1,5 foiz; 4) mayda print; 5) tugatish shartlari. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting. undefined
scenes.say: Explain 5 contract clauses in plain English: inspection, payment deadline, interest, fine print and termination.
scenes.say_uz: 5 ta shartnoma moddasini oddiy ingliz tilida tushuntiring: tekshirish, to‘lov muddati, foiz, mayda print va tugatish.

scenes.title: Namuna javoblar
scenes.say_native: Namuna javoblar. 1) „The inspection clause means you must check the goods within 14 days or you lose the right to complain“ — tekshirish moddasi — 14 kun ichida. 2) „Payment is due within 30 days“ — to‘lov 30 kun ichida. 3) „Late payment means interest at 1.5 % per month“ — kechikish — oyiga 1,5 foiz. 4) „The fine print limits liability and sets termination rules“ — mayda print. 5) „Either party can terminate with 30 days‘ notice“ — 30 kun. Sizning tushuntirishingiz — boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin — muhimi tushunarli va aniq. undefined
scenes.say: The inspection clause: check goods within 14 days or lose the right to complain. Payment is due within 30 days. Late payment accrues interest at 1.5 % per month. The fine print limits liability and sets termination rules. Either party can terminate with 30 days notice.
scenes.say_uz: Tekshirish moddasi: tovarlarni 14 kun ichida tekshiring yoki shikoyat qilish huquqini yo‘qotasiz. To‘lov 30 kun ichida. Kechikish oyiga 1,5 foiz foizga olib keladi. Mayda print javobgarlikni cheklaydi va tugatish qoidalarini belgilaydi. Har qaysi tomon 30 kun oldin ogohlantirish bilan tugatishi mumkin.

scenes.title: Huquqiy lug‘at: aforementioned, hereinafter, notwithstanding

examples.t: The aforementioned clause shall remain valid.
examples.uz: Yukorida aytib o‘tilgan modda o‘zida qoladi.

examples.t: Hereinafter referred to as the Buyer…

scenes.say_native: Huquqiy matnda uchta eng muhim so‘z. Birinchisi — „aforementioned“ — yuqorida aytib o‘tilgan — „The aforementioned clause shall remain valid“ — yukorida aytib o‘tilgan modda o‘zida qoladi. Ikkinchisi — „hereinafter“ — bundan keyin — „hereinafter referred to as the Buyer“ — bundan keyin xaridor sifatida — huquqiy hujjatda bir marta aniqlashtiriladi. Uchinchisi — „notwithstanding“ — qaramay — „Notwithstanding clause 5, the contract shall remain valid“ — 5-moddaga qaramay, shartnoma o‘zida qoladi. Eslab qoling: aforementioned — yuqorida aytib o‘tilgan; hereinafter — bundan keyin; notwithstanding — qaramay — uchala huquqiy matnda har doim.
scenes.say: The aforementioned clause shall remain valid. Hereinafter referred to as the Buyer. Notwithstanding clause 5, the contract shall remain valid. These are the three most important legal words.
scenes.say_uz: Yukorida aytib o‘tilgan modda o‘zida qoladi. Bundan keyin xaridor sifatida ko‘rib chiqiladi. Beshinchi moddaga qaramay, shartnoma o‘zida qoladi. Bular huquqiy matnning uchta eng muhim so‘zlari.

scenes.title: Huquqiy lug‘at mashqi
scenes.say_native: Uchta huquqiy lug‘at gapi tuzing: „The aforementioned clause shall remain valid“; „hereinafter referred to as the Buyer“; „Notwithstanding clause 5…“. Javoblaringizni ingliz tilida ayting.
scenes.say: The aforementioned clause shall remain valid. Hereinafter referred to as the Buyer. Notwithstanding clause 5, the contract shall remain valid. Say the three legal terms aloud in English.
scenes.say_uz: Yukorida aytib o‘tilgan modda o‘zida qoladi. Bundan keyin xaridor sifatida ko‘rib chiqiladi. Beshinchi moddaga qaramay, shartnoma o‘zida qoladi. Bu uchta huquqiy atamani ingliz tilida baland ovozda ayting.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
scenes.say_native: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik? Ingliz tilida huquqiy va rasmiy hujjatlar tilini: shartnoma tuzilishini — parties, whereas, terms, signature; majburiyatlar va shartlarni — shall, in the event that, provided that; rasmiy passiv va nominal uslubni — it is agreed that, hereby; mayda printni — liability, termination, default. Endi har qanday shartnomani tushunasiz. undefined
scenes.say: Today we learned legal and formal English: contract structure, obligations, formal passive style and the fine print. Keep practicing.
